description: This file contains utility methods for working with CompletableFuture, providing mechanisms to combine multiple futures into a single future that yields a list of their results. It includes a method to collect results from a list of CompletableFutures into one CompletableFuture<List<T>>.

classes.name: CompletableFutureUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to work with Java CompletableFuture, notably to collect multiple futures into a single future with a list of results.

methods.name: collectAsList
methods.description: Collects a list of CompletableFutures into a single CompletableFuture that yields a List of their results.

methods.name: collect
methods.description: A private helper method that combines a list of CompletableFutures into a single CompletableFuture with a result transformed by a provided collector.
